New National Telecom Policy
*241. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has recently
formulated a new National Telecom Policy-
2011;
(b) if so, the salient features thereof
and the manner in which the policy
proposes to bring transparency in the
telecom sector and give benefits to the
consumers;
(c) whether suggestions from various
stakeholders, including telecom industry,
were acted upon by Government;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether roaming charges have been
dispensed with, under the new policy; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and the time
by when the new policy is likely to be
introduced and implemented?
MSP for paddy, wheat and coarse grains
*242. SHRI SHYAMAL
CHAKRABORTY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is buying crops at far below the market
price;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the Minimum Support Price (MSP)
fixed for paddy, wheat and coarse grains
for the year 2010 and 2011, respectively;
and
(d) the market price of these products
in the corresponding year?
Introduction of more trains in
Andhra Pradesh
*243. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
rush of passengers for trains like Godavari
Express, Gowthami Express and the
Venkatadri Express in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the reasons for not introducing
more trains on these sectors;
(c) whether there is a shortage of railway
coaches, particularly in South-Central
Railway, or tracks in these sectors; and

Flood and soil erosion in Assam
*244. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of cultivable land and crop
land rendered infertile during floods in
Assam this year;
(b) whether Government has proposed
any provision to compensate the farmers
who lost their cultivable land during floods
and erosion in Assam for the last three years
and the current year; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Gauge conversion on Ratlam-Mhow-
Khandwa railway line
†*245. SHRI MEGHRAJ JAIN: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has taken a
decision of gauge conversion on the Ratlam-
Mhow-Khandwa railway line;
(b) if so, by when the work would start
and by when it would be completed;
(c) the amount earmarked in the budget
for this purpose; and
(d) the details thereof?
Scholarship for girl child
*246. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether scholarship for girl child of
Group D railway employees has been
increased to ` 1200 per month;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount earmarked and spent so
far, zone-wise, especially in South-Central
Railway for the current financial year?
Loss due to train accidents
*247. SHRI T.M. SELVAGANA-
PATHI: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Railways are suffering a net
loss of over ` 100 crore per annum due to
train accidents;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Railways have suffered a
loss of over ` 10,000 crore during the last
two decades;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether most of the train accidents
in the world take place in our country?
Representation of SCs and STs in
institutions of National Importance
*248. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of staff and students
of institutions of National Importance
represented by members of Scheduled
Castes and Scheduled Tribes-communities
in the last five years;
(b) the details thereof;
(c) whether any measures, over and
above those ensured by concerned
legislation and court rulings, have been taken
to secure adequate representation of these
communities;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the number of drop-outs, in the
aforementioned institutions amongst
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Increase in consumption of fertilizers
vis-a-vis agricultural production
*249. PROF. ANIL KUMAR
SAHANI: Will the Minister of
CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether consumption of fertilizers
has increased by 46 per cent from the year
2003-04 to 2008-09 and whether
agricultural production has increased by just
16 per cent over the same period;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
